brief_title: Win streak reveal that lets the screen do the talking
hook_on_screen_text: We were NOT ready for this one

structure.beat: Cold open on the app with one line of text that promises a reveal
Scroll the wins board so the viewer sees real entries, not a mockup
The streak counter flips over and the number fills the screen
End card asks for a comment to get the link

cta: Comment WIN and I will send the link
topic_shown: A daily wins tracker app, recorded on a phone screen
why_it_worked: the first line promises a payoff and the screen recording pays it off before anyone can scroll away, and the top comments ask what app this is
adaptation: swap the wins board for this creator's own planning screen and reveal a real weekly number right after a check in
avoid: The generic five habit apps you need listicle that every account in this niche already posts
